model_adaptations.description: Retain the previous 73 by 58 m footprint and legacy display frame. These are model dimensions, not measurements established by the listed references.

The main entrance between stair cores named North and East is interpreted as the real northeast-facing frontage and approximately registered to legacy +Y. This is not a surveyed geographic bearing or coordinate transform. RF has a different diagram orientation; match named stairs instead of assuming page-up is north.

The proposed south 2F entrance level and straight access stairs adapt a real second-floor entrance to the inherited flat ground. Neither 4.4 m nor this stair layout is established by the photograph or visitor diagrams.

Replace uniform small-window rows with facade-specific brown wall fields, sparse staggered upper windows and a pale main-entrance composition with a thin canopy, tall columns and recessed glazing. Dimensions, panel pitch and unobserved parts remain approximations. The screen-like central surface's exact material is unconfirmed.

Remove the previous generic four-corner HVAC units and add a central brown rooftop volume with an approximately two-level exterior composition, doors, small windows, louver and supported canopy. Its footprint, height, placement and equipment details are estimated; exact internal functions are not established.
Represent differences between solid brown wall/parapet portions and open vertical-picket railing portions. The corner photo does not document the complete perimeter or exact heights.

exclusions: Reproduction or redistribution of source photos, PDFs or floor-guide graphics.
Current logos, event graphics, obsolete aquarium/ONE PIECE or other closed-facility signs.
Survey-grade reconstruction, exact tenant interiors, verified public circulation paths, structural/engineering certification or animated operation.
Treating image upload dates as photograph capture dates or visitor maps as dimensioned drawings.
